items.prompt:
Coming to a discussion having read the material means being:
A) prepared
B) late
C) off-topic

Adding to a classmate's point is called:
A) building on their idea
B) interrupting
C) ignoring them

Adjusting your view when given strong evidence shows you are:
A) open-minded
B) stubborn
C) rude

A classmate gives new evidence that challenges your view. The BEST response is to:
A) acknowledge it and qualify or justify your view with reasons
B) ignore it
C) talk louder
items.answer: A) acknowledge it and qualify or justify your view with reasons

steps: Respond to evidence. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) acknowledge it and qualify or justify your view with reasons

items.prompt:
Why come prepared to a discussion?
A) so you can contribute informed, evidence-based ideas
B) so you can stay silent
C) so you can change the topic
items.answer: A) so you can contribute informed, evidence-based ideas

steps: Preparation enables contribution. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) so you can contribute informed, evidence-based ideas

items.prompt:
The best way to DISAGREE in a discussion is to:
A) politely challenge the idea with reasons
B) insult the person
C) refuse to listen
items.answer: A) politely challenge the idea with reasons

steps: Attack ideas, not people. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) politely challenge the idea with reasons

items.prompt:
Which contribution BEST connects two classmates' ideas?
A) 'Leo said the law cut traffic; Nadia said it raised costs. Could both be true, and if so, is it worth it?'
B) 'That's wrong.'
C) 'Anyway, my turn.'
items.answer: A) 'Leo said the law cut traffic; Nadia said it raised costs. Could both be true, and if so, is it worth it?'

steps: Ties ideas with a question. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) 'Leo said the law cut traffic; Nadia said it raised costs. Could both be true, and if so, is it worth it?'

items.prompt:
A productive 8th-grade discussion includes:
A) preparation, active listening, connecting questions, and qualifying views with evidence
B) one person talking the whole time
C) everyone talking at once
items.answer: A) preparation, active listening, connecting questions, and qualifying views with evidence

solution.answer: A) preparation, active listening, connecting questions, and qualifying views with evidence
